remarks: Live where every day feels a little more like a vacation. Set in a fantastic East Norwalk location within walking distance to Calf Pasture Beach, this spacious townhouse style half duplex offers more than 2,500 square feet of sun filled living space close to waterfront recreation and some of the area's best dining. The open floor plan offers a comfortable sense of flow and well suited to the way you live today. Hardwood floors run throughout the main and second levels. The living room features a fireplace, while the kitchen offers granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and a natural connection to the surrounding living spaces. Sliders open to a deck overlooking the backyard, extending the main level outdoors. A half bath and direct access to the garage add everyday convenience. Upstairs, the generously sized primary bedroom suite provides a comfortable private retreat. Two additional bedrooms share a hall bathroom, offering plenty of space for family, guests or a home office. The third floor is an unexpected bonus. Measuring approximately 43x24 feet, this expansive room offers remarkable flexibility for an office, gym, game room, creative studio, craft space or whatever suits your lifestyle. With exceptional living space, a versatile floor plan and a location that puts the beach, dining, recreation and everything East Norwalk has to offer close at hand, this is an opportunity to enjoy an outstanding lifestyle!
